suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Establish a convention for scratch/debug scripts (e.g., place in `.tmp/` or use specific extensions) so they do not break project-wide linting.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: In daily-log-writer, the worker encountered lint errors from pre-existing untracked scripts and added them to eslint.config.js to pass validation.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Reinforce the safeParseJSON utility convention over standard JSON.parse with try/catch blocks for safety.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: In memory-consolidator, the worker used standard JSON.parse instead of the mandated safeParseJSON utility.
